claims.statement: Tom Allen left Chicago on Wednesday evening for St. Louis, and was not expected there before Monday.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen left Chicago on Wednesday evenipg, so it is understood, for St. Louis,

claims.statement: Fred Watkins thought Tom Allen would continue to live in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Fred Watkins is best acquainted with Tom’ s present intentions and he thinks the champion will continue his residence in this city.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss were expected to meet soon for a battle, with arrangements to be perfected.
claims.excerpt: a meeting between the two will take place verv soon and arrangements perfected for a battle
